activities.activity_description: Update Reactor dependencies to version 2.0.4, resolve compatibility issues, and run regression tests.
Modify Ambari configurations to support multiple XD-Admin instances for high availability and validate failover scenarios.
Design and implement the @EnableModule annotation, integrate @Input/@Output channel creation logic, and update module configuration handling.
Finalize remaining Kryo serialization optimizations, update documentation, and ensure performance benchmarks are met.
Set up CI test suites on EC2, configure build pipelines, and validate test execution reliability.
Research and prototype techniques for installing XD modules from Maven repositories via CLI, including artifactId resolution.
